en.title: Asset Analysis
en.stamp: As of Tuesday, September 29, 2026. rising real yields and widening credit spreads set the tone
en.banner: The tape is being driven by a sharp rise in the 10 year, with the real yield at **2.90%** and the nominal at **5.24%**, while high yield spreads widened to **302** bp. Cash pays well with fed funds held at **3.88%**, and risk assets from gold to bitcoin are absorbing the pressure.

assets.name: US Stocks
assets.one: Rising real yields and widening spreads are squeezing equities, but volatility stays calm near **16.04** and the index sits only **1.9%** below its 52 week high.
assets.qual: bottoming, the drawdown is shallow and orderly with volatility contained, so the downside is being absorbed rather than accelerating

factors.b: Industrial production grew just **1.4%** year over year in August, near the softest pace of the past five months.
High yield spreads widened to **302** bp, the highest of the last five observations.
VIX stands at **16.04**, still in a low and normal range despite the equity pullback.

assets.name: US Cash
assets.one: Cash earns a solid real return with fed funds held at **3.88%** and the 3 month bill at **4.28%**, while risk assets falter around it.
assets.qual: high held rates and a positive real carry make T bills the cleanest asset in the tape right now

factors.b: Fed funds effective has been held at **3.88%** across all five recent observations.
Real carry on cash against core CPI is **1.83** percent, comfortably positive.
Core CPI has cooled to **2.4%** year over year, a direction that invites rate cuts ahead.

assets.name: Gold
assets.one: Gold at **$4,215** trades **7.5%** below its 200 day average with real yields at **2.90%** and the dollar firm.
assets.qual: rising real yields and a firm dollar are draining the monetary bid, and price has lost trend support

factors.b: The 10 year real yield rose to **2.90%**, the highest of its last five observations.
The dollar index sits at **101.38**, which is **2.2%** above its 200 day average.
The 10 year breakeven holds steady at **2.35%** across the last five observations.

assets.name: Crypto
assets.one: Bitcoin at **$83,510** stays well above its moving averages, but rising real yields, a firm dollar and held tight policy press the liquidity trade.
assets.qual: tight liquidity and a rising dollar outweigh an intact price trend, leaving bitcoin exposed to further multiple compression in risk assets

factors.b: The 10 year real yield at **2.90%** has risen from **2.63%** over five observations.
The dollar index rose to **101.38** with a five session gain of **0.8%**.
Bitcoin trades **8.6%** above its 50 day average of **$76,870**.

matrix.r: Industrial production up 1.4% year over year
High yield OAS at 302 bp and widening
10 year real yield at 2.90% and rising

1.83 percent against core CPI
Core CPI at 2.4% year over year and falling
VIX at 16.04, low and normal
S&P 500 1.9% below its 52 week high
Dollar index at 101.38, above its 200 day average
Gold 7.5% below its 200 day average
Bitcoin 8.6% above its 50 day average
10 year breakeven steady at 2.35%

tiles.read: The 10 year real yield at 2.90% is the highest of the recent run, a direct headwind for gold, crypto and equity multiples.
The nominal 10 year at 5.24% has climbed steadily from 4.96%, tightening financial conditions.
The breakeven steady at 2.35% shows inflation expectations are anchored even as nominal yields rise.
High yield spreads at 302 bp are the widest of the last five observations, signaling creeping credit caution.
The 3 month bill at 4.28% keeps cash carry attractive and rising at the short end.
Fed funds effective held at 3.88% confirms policy is on hold, not easing.
VIX at 16.04 is calm, so the equity pullback is orderly rather than panicked.
The S&P 500 at 7,671 sits just 1.9% below its 52 week high, holding most of its gains.
Bitcoin at $83,510 is down 1% over five sessions but remains well above its key moving averages.

tiles.src: Yahoo Finance, COMEX front month, September 29
tiles.read: Gold at $4,215 has fallen 3.9% over five sessions and now trades below its 200 day average.
The dollar index at 101.38 is firm and above its 200 day average, a drag on non dollar assets.

calcs.note: Cross checks against FRED DFII10 at 2.90 percent, a gap of 1 basis points from the different observation dates.

calcs.lab: Real carry on cash, against core CPI
calcs.note: What a 3 month T bill pays after core inflation, for taking no duration and no credit risk. Core CPI is the August print.

calcs.note: Headline includes food and energy, so this is the number a household actually feels.
The 200 day line is the trend filter the framework uses for crypto.
Gold rejecting or reclaiming this line has capped every advance this cycle.

zh.title: 资产分析
zh.stamp: 截至 2026 年 9 月 29 日，星期二。 实际利率上升与信用利差走阔定下基调
zh.banner: 行情由 10 年期利率的急升主导，实际利率为 **2.90%**，名义利率为 **5.24%**，高收益利差走阔至 **302** bp。联邦基金利率维持在 **3.88%**，现金回报可观，从黄金到比特币的风险资产正在承受压力。

assets.name: 美股
assets.one: 实际利率上升与利差走阔正在挤压股票，但波动率在 **16.04** 附近保持平静，指数仅比 52 周高点低 **1.9%**。
assets.qual: 筑底中，回撤浅且有序，波动率受控，下行压力正在被吸收而非加速

factors.b: 工业产出同比仅增长 **1.4%**，接近近五个月最疲软的水平。
高收益利差走阔至 **302** bp，为近五次观测中的最高水平。
VIX 处于 **16.04**，尽管股票回调，仍处于低位正常区间。

assets.name: 美元现金
assets.one: 联邦基金利率维持在 **3.88%**，3 个月期国库券收益 **4.28%**，现金获得稳健的实际回报，而周边风险资产表现不佳。
assets.qual: 利率维持高位加上正的实际利差，使国库券成为当前行情中最干净的资产

factors.h: 联邦基金利率水平与倾向
factors.b: 联邦基金有效利率在最近五次观测中均维持在 **3.88%**。
现金相对核心 CPI 的实际利差为 **1.83**%，稳稳为正。
核心 CPI 同比已降温至 **2.4%**，这一方向为后续降息留出空间。

assets.name: 黄金
assets.qual: 实际利率上升与美元坚挺正在抽离货币性买盘，价格已失去趋势支撑

factors.b: 10 年期实际利率升至 **2.90%**，为近五次观测中的最高水平。
10 年期盈亏平衡通胀在近五次观测中稳定于 **2.35%**。

assets.name: 加密资产
assets.one: 比特币报 **$83,510**，仍远高于其均线，但实际利率上升、美元坚挺与政策维持紧缩正压制流动性交易。
assets.qual: 流动性收紧与美元走强压过完好的价格趋势，比特币面临风险资产估值倍数进一步压缩的风险

factors.b: 10 年期实际利率报 **2.90%**，在五次观测中从 **2.63%** 升至此位。
美元指数升至 **101.38**，五个交易日累计上涨 **0.8%**。

tiles.read: 10 年期实际利率报 2.90%，为近期走势中的最高，对黄金、加密货币和股票估值倍数构成直接阻力。
10 年期名义利率报 5.24%，从 4.96% 稳步攀升，金融环境趋紧。
盈亏平衡通胀稳定于 2.35%，表明即便名义利率上升，通胀预期依然锚定。
高收益利差报 302 bp，为近五次观测中最宽，显示信用市场的谨慎情绪在悄悄蔓延。
3 个月期国库券报 4.28%，使现金利差保持吸引力，且短端收益仍在上升。
联邦基金有效利率维持在 3.88%，确认政策处于观望而非宽松。
VIX 报 16.04，情绪平静，股票回调有序而非恐慌。
标普 500 报 7,671，仅比 52 周高点低 1.9%，保住了大部分涨幅。
